findings.title: Review cutoff still trusts report timestamps when original Go stream contradicts them
findings.impact: The v2 ordering check rejects future self-reported dates, but takes native clocks only from report.started_at/ended_at. The pinned raw Go JSONL and original process completion are not bound to those clocks. Earlier review can still pass when the raw stream carries later execution times.
findings.evidence: Independent control called the actual trusted verify_native consumer on isolated synthetic Go JSONL with Time=2026-10-20. Report end=2026-10-01 and real _review_execution_cutoff with review=2026-10-03 both passed. No Go process ran and no full formal owner was accepted.
findings.required_fix: Derive or validate Native and dispatcher completion against the pinned original execution record and raw stream timestamps, including identified process/run provenance. Reject report/raw-clock contradictions. Keep GLOBAL completion bounded to those original execution intervals and the independent review/Root receipt.

findings.title: Uppercase .RAW additions evade the Windows owned-inventory CAS
findings.impact: _owned_inventory uses case-sensitive name.endswith(".raw"), whereas the producer and trusted closure use Windows Path.rglob("*.raw") with case-insensitive matching. Added extra.RAW changes the actual closure member set but recheck_inputs remains PASS.
findings.evidence: Real Windows Reader + _owned_inventory + recheck_inputs over the isolated own review repository: original one.raw pinned; extra.RAW added; closure-equivalent rglob includes both; CAS returns PASS. Lowercase addition, deletion, changed bytes and conflicting prior hashes correctly reject.
findings.required_fix: Use the same explicit case semantics and membership algorithm in producer, closure, initial inventory and CAS. Add Windows .RAW/mixed-case and nested-member tests. Retain the new compare-before-register behavior.

findings.title: Fixed Root paths still accept fabricated original collaboration events
findings.impact: The fixed index and origin schemas contain only asserted writer_actor/source/sender/recipient/event_id/content. The code does not validate an original tool event, channel or thread identity, or evidence that Root actually received the event. Moving self-reported JSON into root_original_events does not establish this authority.
findings.evidence: Independent control used the real Reader and all exact fixed prefixes/pins. A fully invented index, capture and custom-schema origin with event_id=invented-event-with-no-tool-channel was accepted by unchanged _root_original. No real original collaboration event exists. Missing registration, author receipt path and pinned byte tampering correctly reject.
findings.required_fix: Consume and validate a real Root-captured original delivery record, retaining source event shape/identity, channel/thread, actual sender/recipient, exact message bytes and receive time. Bind the capture registry to that independently established provenance. An author-supplied custom schema or source string cannot be the original evidence. Keep actual capture OPEN until Root receives it.
